newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telebras 7-mo net due this week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras 7-mo net due this week.

text.p: Brazilian federally owned telecommunications giant Telebras is due to release its January through July financial results this week, a company spokesman said.
"They should be out Thursday, Friday at the latest," the spokesman said.
"It will be the results for the first seven months of the year," he added.
Traders said Telebras should show strong July figures due to extra revenue stemming from heavy communications traffic as a result of the Atlanta Olympics.

Earlier this month, Telebras released strong six-month results, including a consolidated net profit of 1.343 billion reais, up some 272 percent from the January-June 1995 period due mostly to higher tariffs.
Telebras' holding reported a first-half net profit of 1.627 billion reais.
The six-month results were in line with market expectations, analysts said.
